## ProviderSubscriptionRanges

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.Core.ProviderSubscriptionRanges</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Core/ProviderSubscriptionRanges.cs:23](../../../../src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Core/ProviderSubscriptionRanges.cs#L23).

Centralized subscription ID ranges for each provider to prevent collisions. Each provider allocates subscription IDs from a designated range to ensure unique IDs across the application. This prevents confusion when debugging subscription issues and ensures proper unsubscription. Range allocation: - 100,000-199,999: Alpaca Markets - 200,000-299,999: Polygon.io - 300,000-399,999: Interactive Brokers - 400,000-499,999: NYSE - 500,000+: Reserved for future providers Usage: private readonly SubscriptionManager _subscriptionManager = new(startingId: ProviderSubscriptionRanges.AlpacaStart);

## WebSocketProviderBase

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.Core.WebSocketProviderBase</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Core/WebSocketProviderBase.cs:35](../../../../src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Core/WebSocketProviderBase.cs#L35).

Abstract base class for WebSocket-based streaming market data providers. Consolidates connection lifecycle, heartbeat monitoring, and automatic reconnection logic that was previously duplicated across Alpaca, Polygon, and NYSE. Derived classes implement protocol-specific hooks: AuthenticateAsync — send provider-specific auth messages HandleMessageAsync — parse and route incoming messages ResubscribeAsync — re-subscribe symbols after reconnection BuildWebSocketUri — construct the provider-specific endpoint URI ConfigureWebSocket — set provider-specific headers/options

```csharp
public abstract class WebSocketProviderBase : IMarketDataClient, IProviderConnectionDiagnosticsSource, IProviderRateLimitDiagnosticsSource, IReconnectionGapSource
```
